synopsis.en: Following a vicious internal conflict, two brothers are expelled from the gang representing their beloved soccer club. They are forced to navigate a dangerous landscape of marginality, corruption, and power struggles as they attempt to survive outside the hierarchy of the gang.
synopsis.es: Tras un feroz conflicto interno, dos hermanos son expulsados de la barra brava de su amado club de fútbol. Se ven obligados a navegar por un peligroso mundo de marginalidad, corrupción y luchas de poder mientras intentan sobrevivir fuera de la jerarquía de la pandilla.
